about_the_game:
🎴 Yaku Slap Demo – Walk the Flower Path and Slap Down Monsters! 🌸

Ready to duel monsters, master ancient card combos, and get just a little addicted to slapping down the perfect hand? Yaku Slap blends the strategic flair of Hanafuda Koi Koi with rogue-like chaos where every match could be your last—or your ultimate victory.

Collect powerful spells, master rare Yaku combinations, and score big as you fight your way down the Flower Path to become a true Yaku Master. 

🎴 Features in the Demo:

  • 🌿 Strategic Card Combat: Master the classic Koi Koi mechanics with a supernatural twist.

  • 🃏 Monster Showdowns: Duel dangerous creatures that are as challenging as they are zany—slap hard or get slapped!

  • 🎮 Spells items and split cards:

  • 😈 Cheeky Humor & Style: Relaxing vibes meet monster-smacking fun.

🚫Not in the demo:

  • 🌸 Rogue-like Progression: Not Available in the Demo. (Classes, passives and perks will be available in the full version)

  • The full roster of bosses: This demo give a quick vertical slice of the game and allows you to play up to the first boss.

  • Endless looping: The option to keep playing after defeating the boss

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Window 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 @3.0 GHz or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Only runs on 64 bit systems
